terms.gloss: a comfort, a solace, something that eases grief
evidence: Cic. Tusc. 2.59: haec sunt sōlācia, haec fōmenta summōrum dolōrum (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Sōlāciō esse (dative), to be a comfort to someone.

terms.gloss: the act of consoling; words of comfort
evidence: Cic. Tusc. 3.77: nōn egēre cōnsōlātiōne (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: haec sunt sōlācia, haec fōmenta summōrum dolōrum
phrases.english: these are the comforts, these the poultices for the greatest pains

sources: Lewis & Short: solacium · Lewis & Short: consolatio
